description: This file contains implementation of symbolic shape analysis for TorchScript graphs, including classes and functions for shape argument handling, shape graph analysis, and shape propagation within the JIT compiler.

classes.name: ShapeArg
classes.description: Represents a shape argument which can be a symbolic shape, a constant integer, or unknown.

classes.name: ShapeArguments
classes.description: Encapsulates a list of shape arguments, supporting symbolic and concrete dimensions.

classes.name: SSArgument
classes.description: Variant type for shape arguments, either ShapeArguments or IValue.

classes.name: SymbolicShapeOpAnalyzer
classes.description: Analyzes and propagates symbolic shape information through a shape compute graph.

classes.name: SymbolicShapeGraphAnalyzer
classes.description: Builds and analyzes a symbolic shape graph over a region of a TorchScript graph.

methods.name: tensorShapeArg
methods.description: Extracts shape argument info from a tensor value.

methods.name: getNodeInputShapes
methods.description: Retrieves shape arguments for inputs of a node.

methods.name: applyOutputShapeToGraph
methods.description: Sets output tensor types based on computed symbolic shapes.

methods.name: PropagateShapesWithShapeFunction
methods.description: Propagates shape info through a node using a shape compute graph.

methods.name: PropagateShapesOnGraph
methods.description: Recursively propagates shape info across a graph.

methods.name: PropagateShapesOnBlock
methods.description: Propagates shape info within a block.

methods.name: calculateSymbolicShapesOnOp
methods.description: Calculates symbolic shapes for an operation based on its schema and inputs.
